notes.title: 2025/05/15 Ver.1.0.3 Update!
notes.notes:
◆ Additions
- Added a UI for comparing equipped gems in the gem equipment screen
- Added an "E" mark to indicate equipped weapons in the weapon equipment screen
- Added an apply button to the sort menu
- Added support for Steam Cloud

◆ Changes & Adjustments
- Moved text and sort icons above the gem list in the sort menu
- Changed weapon list to be sorted by highest rarity
- Adjusted behavior of gem/weapon display on the result screen
- Changed acquired weapon list on result screen to sort by rarity
- Adjusted dungeon mode drop tables
- Adjusted Monk’s poise break effectiveness
- Adjusted size of the full map
- Adjusted enemy behavior so that they briefly turn toward the player when flinching
- Minor adjustments

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where effects would remain if a boss cutscene plays during Sorcerer casting
- Fixed an issue where Kani-Karni’s claw sounds could be heard from far away
- Fixed a bug where multiple sort options could be selected at once

notes.title: 2025/04/17 Ver.1.0.2 Update!
notes.notes:
◆ Added Features
- Added color variation versions for some hairstyle accessories
- Added large map display function
※ Toggle with the Select button or the M key

◆ Changes and Adjustments
- Adjusted so that lock-on no longer targets the switch in 4-2
- Adjusted so that the player becomes invincible for 1 second after flinching
- Adjusted to make the player less likely to flinch
- Adjusted to make most enemies easier to flinch (excluding some)
- Overall adjustment to Fighter skills
- Character can now be rotated on the character creation screen
※ Use the right stick or Q/R keys to control

◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue in 5-1 where certain areas couldn’t be entered while running
- Fixed a rare issue where the tutorial monster becomes overly strong
- Fixed an issue where gem sub-stats were sometimes not displayed when selling

notes.title: 2025/04/10 Ver.1.0.1 Update!
notes.notes:
◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the lock-on would remain after activating a lever switch.
- Character Creation: Fixed a bug where the scrollbar would appear in the bangs section.
※ There is no change in the number of available items.
- Fixed an issue where the King Honenchu remained invincible if broken just before backstepping.
- Fixed an issue where pressing the start button during boss intro scenes wouldn’t skip the animation.
- Shop: Fixed an issue where items could be purchased even if the quantity was set to 0.
- Fixed a rare issue where the player would keep moving after pressing the start button.

◆ Changes and Adjustments
- When launching the game with save data present, it now defaults to “Load.”
- Adjusted some enemy effects and hitboxes to disappear when flinching or being defeated.
※ Example: Salamander’s breath
- Added a pre-attack animation to Sakanan-chu’s thrust attack.
- Adjusted lock-on duration for Sakanan-chu’s sweeping attack.
- Result Screen: Adjusted how weapon stats are displayed.
- Minor UI text adjustments.

◆ New Features
- Added a feature to show lock-on markers above enemy heads or parts being targeted.
- Added a setting to manually change controller button icons.
※ Available in the Control Settings menu.
- When using “Keyboard & Mouse” mode, the icons are fixed to that input method.

◆ Final Note
We continue to make adjustments based on all your valuable feedback to ensure a better gameplay environment.
Thank you for your continued support of SD Dungeons!

notes.title: 2025/03/23 – Demo Update!
notes.notes:
◆ Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the achievement "Long play!" was triggered incorrectly.
- Fixed the scroll behavior to function properly.

◆ Changes & Adjustments
- Changed the icons of some avatar parts.
- Adjusted the gem set effects for the Adventurer Series.
- Changed the names and models of some weapons.
- Updated the shop to display an icon when new items are added.
- Modified the item drop effects.
- Adjusted the stats of some enemies.
- Adjusted gem stats.
- Other UI adjustments.

◆ New Additions
- Added a gem sorting feature.
- Added a weapon appearance customization feature.
- Added Korean language support.
- Added a new screen resolution (3840x2160).

◆ Other
- Added support for Steam Deck.

notes.notes:
